thread:
anya: heads-up: i'm consolidating a few terminology updates and want to coordinate the docs PRs so we don't cause churn for SDK users. Planning to land late this week.

mike: list the updates here so the SDK and examples teams can sync.

anya: sure. shortlist: `model_key` -> `model_id`; `dedicated capacity` -> `Dedicated` (product name); prefer 'model variant' over 'fallback' but include `(fallback)` on first mention; expand acronyms on first use (e.g., 'RLHF' -> 'reinforcement learning from human feedback'). Also unify on 'token pricing' vs 'per-token pricing' to 'per-token' in captions.

priya: noted. i'll add canonical rows to the style guide table. any prefs for code samples param names?

mike: if we change `model_key` to `model_id` in examples, will that break anything? We can keep a backward-compatible alias in SDKs but docs should use `model_id`.

leo: i'm working on the Go SDK snippets; fine with `model_id`. i'll add a comment in the snippet noting the migration.

sam: i'll run a pattern search across /docs, /examples, and /snippets for the old terms and create a fix branch. watch out for sentence-level uses vs code identifiers (e.g., `model_key` vs "model key").

anya: good point. please use regex that captures code fences and inline code. Also unify capitalization: product names Title Case, generic nouns lowercase.

priya: adding entries: 
- canonical: model_id | old: model_key | notes: use `model_id` in code and prose; SDKs accept both during transition.
- canonical: Dedicated | old: dedicated capacity | notes: Title Case for product.
- canonical: model variant (fallback) | old: fallback model | notes: first mention includes (fallback).
- canonical: reinforcement learning from human feedback | old: RLHF | notes: spell out at first mention, acronym allowed after.
- canonical: per-token | old: token pricing, per-token pricing | notes: use "per-token" in UI and captions.

mike: i'll update Python and JS quickstarts. sample replacement in Python: 
```
# before
resp = client.generate(model_key="redwood/gpt-medium", prompt="Hi")
# after
resp = client.generate(model_id="redwood/gpt-medium", prompt="Hi")
```
I'll include a short migration note above the snippet.

leo: for Go I'll add a note in godocs and a small deprecation comment on the older field.

sam: found 7 occurrences of `model_key` in examples and 2 in /docs/guides. pushing branch docs/fix-model-id-terms and will reference this thread.

priya: please also update the glossary page with crosslinks: `model variant` should link to the model management guide.

anya: docs-bot, can you run the anchor and heading checker after the branches are up?

docs-bot: acknowledged. will run checks for PRs referenced in this thread once they're created.

mike: opened PRs: 
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/801 (python/js quickstarts)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/202 (example snippets)

leo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/604 (go snippets).

sam: my branch is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/803 replacing site occurrences. note: i preserved older phrasing in changelog entries where historical accuracy matters.

priya: merged the style guide change into a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/800. includes the canonical table and a tiny section on "How to introduce renamed params in examples".

docs-bot: link and anchor check queued for PRs: 800, 801, 803, 604, 202. initial smoke report: 2 anchor mismatches (glossary -> model-management link), 1 broken image in examples/embedding/README.

anya: sam, can you patch the glossary anchor? mike/leo, fix any image paths in your PRs. i'll wait for green from docs-bot before merging the canonicalization PR.

sam: quick fix pushed for the glossary anchor, referenced in PR 803.

mike: fixed image path in examples PR. updated migration note to say SDKs will accept both names for two releases.

leo: updated go PR to include deprecation text and example comments.

docs-bot: re-run complete: all anchors resolved, no broken links. ready for review.

anya: plan: merge order -> examples & SDK PRs first (so consumers see updated snippets), then canonicalization/style guide PR. this reduces churn and avoids redirects. target: merge by COB Friday.

priya: will add changelog blurb under "Docs updates" describing the rename and linking to migration notes.

mike: will leave short note in quickstart: "Note: parameter renamed from `model_key` to `model_id`; older forms accepted until vX.Y".

sam: will watch for any issues after deploy and roll back if we see something breaking.

anya: thanks all. if you spot any edge-case phrasing where 'fallback' must remain (legal text?), ping me and we'll keep it. otherwise i'll close thread after merges. :slightly_smiling_face:
